verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a Management API for terminal management, but the only API capability shown is ordering terminals and accessories for delivery. General terminal management is documented only through the Customer Area UI. Missing for 10: documented API device registration/assignment, API status monitoring of terminals, remote configuration updates via API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage a fleet of readers and terminals via API — register devices, monitor status, and update configuration remotely

citations.quote: The Management API lets you order terminals and accessories for delivery to a location of your choice using API requests instead of the Customer Area.
